intent: A dark, monochrome search field that understands a small query grammar. Typing in:, from: or is: offers that operator's values; a finished token becomes a removable chip inside the field, one per operator. The empty focused field shows recent searches, and the ⌘K keycap at rest morphs into the round clear button once there is content. It reports { query, scopes }; results are the host's job.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (@container on the root, arbitrary values) plus one iss- namespaced style block for the field ring, hover, focus halo, hidden scrollbar and extended hit areas
stack.animation: motion/react: layout springs for chips, AnimatePresence popLayout for chips, the clear-button contents and panel modes, a shared layoutId for the active row, measured height for the panel
stack.icons: lucide-react: Search, X, History, CornerDownLeft, FileText, CircleDot, MessagesSquare, PenTool, CalendarDays, Circle, CircleDashed, CircleCheck, Archive

layout.root: @container, full width up to 600px; the panel is absolutely positioned 8px under the field at the same width, inside the root
layout.field: 48px (md) or 56px (lg) tall, radius 12px / 14px, side padding 14px / 16px: search glyph 18px / 20px, a scrolling row (hidden scrollbar, scrolled to the end when chips change) of chips then the input (flex 1, min 9ch), then the keycap/clear slot
layout.chip: 26px / 30px tall, radius 7px, padding 8px left 4px right, 6px apart: mono operator key, value glyph (icon or initials avatar), short name, 18px remove button with a hit area extended 9px vertically
layout.panel: radius 14px, 6px padding; mono header row (title left, key hint right from @md); rows 40px / 44px, radius 9px, 26px tile, label, 13px detail from @sm, mono tabular meta, 22px slot for the active key; footer 'Narrow with' plus 28px mono operator buttons in recents and idle modes
layout.modes: recents (empty field), values (trailing key:partial for a known operator), query (text or chips: a Search row plus operator suggestions when the last bare word starts an operator key), idle (footer only)
layout.collapse: at narrow widths the detail line and the header key hint hide below the @sm and @md container widths; chips and text scroll horizontally inside the field rather than wrapping

typography.input: sans 16px (md) / 18px (lg), tracking -0.005em, so iOS never zooms
typography.rows: 14px / 15px; detail 13px; matched run in the accent at weight 600

color.accent: one prop, default the theme's ink: matched letters, caret, the active row's key and a 4px focus halo mixed to 14%

motion.clearMorph: one button animates width, height, radius and fill between a 38x22px keycap (radius 6) and a 26px circle over 300ms cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1); '⌘ K' and the X swap inside with scale 0.6 and a 3px blur; with the hint off the circle grows from width 0
motion.chips: enter from scale 0.88 and 4px blur in 220ms ease-out [0.22,1,0.36,1]; layout spring stiffness 500 damping 40; a replaced value cross-fades 5px up
motion.panel: opens from y -6, scale 0.985, 4px blur in 240ms; closes in 160ms ease-in; height follows measured content over 280ms; modes cross-fade with 4px offset and 3px blur; rows stagger 40ms (capped after five); active fill travels with a shared layoutId on the same spring
motion.reducedMotion: opacity only, 140ms; no transforms, blur, stagger or springs

responsive: Container-driven. Works from a 320px column (chips scroll inside the field, detail and key hints hide) to a 600px max width. Touch targets for chip removal and operator buttons are extended with pseudo-element hit areas.
accessibility: Input is a combobox with aria-autocomplete=list, aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant; suggestions are a listbox of options with aria-selected
Chips are a labelled list; each remove button is labelled 'Remove scope in: Docs'
Clear button is labelled 'Clear search'; while it is the keycap it is aria-hidden and out of the tab order
aria-keyshortcuts names Meta+K and Control+K; the shortcut focuses and selects the field
Arrow keys move and wrap, Enter picks or submits, Tab completes values and operators, Esc closes then clears, Backspace at the start arms then removes the last chip
A polite live region announces added, changed and removed scopes, searches and clears
The closed panel is inert and aria-hidden; keyboard focus shows a 2px outline offset 2px

content.operators: in: Docs (Specs, RFCs and the wiki, 1,284), Issues (3,906), Threads (712), Designs (248), Meetings (96); from: Mara Ilić @mara Design, Jonah Feld @jonah Platform, Inès Okafor @ines Growth, Theo Brandt @theo Support; is: Open, Draft, Shipped, Archived
content.recents: in:issues is:open 'checkout timeout' 12m; from:mara 'Q3 roadmap' 2h; in:docs 'onboarding email copy' Yesterday; 'billing webhook retries' Mon
content.demo: Focus shows recents, type in:, pick Docs, type 'onboarding flow', clear with the X; searches you run join the recents

avoid: A results list, network calls or a fake loading state: results belong to the host
Coloured chips per operator, glows or gradients
A panel that pushes content down instead of floating
The ⌘K hint and an X shown side by side instead of one shape that morphs
Chips that wrap the field onto two lines
Losing input focus when a suggestion is clicked
robustness: Resolve all complete known tokens in pasted text as well as individually typed tokens. Preserve unknown operators and values as free text. Never submit or complete a suggestion during IME composition.
